name: MKVentures Capital Limited
about: MKVentures Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the financing and investment business in India. The company operates through Loan and Investment, Consultancy, and Others segment. It provides corporate term loans, channel financing, and investments linked to/arising out of lending business; and financial consultancy to corporates seeking term loans. The company was formerly known as Ikab Securities & Investment Limited and changed its name to MKVentures Capital Limited in November 2022. MKVentures Capital Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
